# Path rules of the truST compile check (.github/scripts/ci_changes.py prints
# plcopen=true when a changed path matches one): the PLCopen writer and
# targets, the copy programs and the library they carry, the PLCopen tests
# and their data, the truST pin and the shared CI files. One fnmatch
# pattern per line on the repository path, where * also matches /.

tools/deploy/canworks/plcopen*.py
tools/deploy/canworks/openplcmodbus.py
tools/deploy/canworks/modbusmap.py
tools/deploy/canworks/plclibrary.py
tools/deploy/canworks/library/*
tools/deploy/tests/test_plcopen.py
tools/deploy/tests/data/plcopen/*
library/*
test/plcopen/*
.github/*
